name: VEX V5 Speed Tank (6-motor)
description: Fast 6-motor VEX V5 competition drive: 6 x 11 W Smart Motors with blue (600 rpm) cartridges geared 36:48 to 3.25 in wheels (450 rpm at the wheel). Omni wheels on the corners and traction wheels in the middle are the usual mix; the spec records one wheel size. The drive uses 66 of the 88 W V5RC motor budget, leaving 22 W for mechanisms. Motor numbers are VEX's published ratings; mass and size are typical values, not measurements of one robot.
